fields.evidence: Windows: adder bg3.exe+0x781BA0 allocates 4-byte one-frame storage and zeroes it; its caller bg3.exe+0x781040 (splatter update) keeps a per-entity uint32 map at system+0x18 (keys +0x38, values +0x48), sets the value to 0xF for every entity of one query (line 'value = 0xf') and copies the 4-byte value into this component ('*comp = *value') for each changed splatter entity. Read by ecl::VisualSystem::Update (macOS). Live (client, fight): 2 and 0xF - a bit mask of the splatter channels that changed (0xF = all four).

open_questions: Which bit is which splatter channel (blood, dirt, wet, bruise...) is not traced; the name is ours to give.
second_pass: Width and kind confirmed on Windows: adder bg3.exe+0x781BA0 (4-byte storage, zeroed) and writer bg3.exe+0x781040, which copies a 4-byte per-entity mask into it and uses 0xF for 'all channels'.
